name: Chickpea Burger
steps: Finely chop onion and garlic. Cook onion in 10 ml oil for 5 minutes; add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Cool.
Dry-roast gram flour for 3 minutes over low heat. Grind oats to coarse flour and pat drained chickpeas dry.
Mash chickpeas coarsely. Mix in cooked onion, gram flour, oats, cumin, paprika, salt and lemon juice. Form 4 firm patties about 2 cm thick and chill for 20 minutes.
Heat remaining 30 ml oil in a nonstick pan. Cook patties over medium-low heat for 5 minutes per side until browned and hot through, turning gently once the crust sets.
Split and lightly toast buns. Spread mayonnaise, add lettuce, tomato slices and a hot chickpea patty, then close and serve.
tips: Keep some chickpea texture rather than blending into hummus; drain well for patties that hold together.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
